paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: Token Ratio (TR).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the Token Ratio (TR) for three different language models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation benchmarks: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The horizontal axis lists these benchmarks in order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the Token Ratio, scaled linearly from 0 to 1.00, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.20. For each benchmark, three bars are grouped side-by-side: the leftmost bar (dark purple) represents RedWhale (our), the middle bar (light blue) represents EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and the rightmost bar (light gray) represents SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The exact Token Ratio values are labeled above each bar. For PT-EVAL, the values are 0.42 for RedWhale, 0.46 for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and 1.00 for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0. For KoBEST-BQ, they are 0.52, 0.56, and 1.00 respectively. For KoBEST-CP, they are 0.71, 0.74, and 1.00. For KoBEST-HS, they are 0.50, 0.54, and 1.00. For KoBEST-SN, they are 0.69, 0.73, and 1.00. For the AVG category, the values are 0.57, 0.61, and 1.00. The bars are not sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard color coding and labeling.
